question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Loudmouth
solution:
The correct answer is **'one who talks boastfully'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'Loudmouth'** is **'one who talks boastfully'.**
 
• **Loudmouth**: a person who tends to talk too much in an offensive or tactless way. (ज़ोर-ज़ोर से या अभद्र बातें करनेवाला; वाचाल)
 
 
• *Example: He was known to be a **loud-mouthed**, opinionated bigot.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate meaning of the given word is expressed by** Option 2**.

 

**Correct Answer:__** *One who talks boastfully.*
